categories.main_business_segments: Xinlei Compressor Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of energy-efficient and high-performance air compressors, blowers, and HVAC equipment including magnetic levitation centrifugal chillers and heat pumps. The company offers over 300 models across six platforms, serving industries such as machinery manufacturing, petrochemicals, metallurgy, textiles, medical, food, cement, wastewater treatment, power, aquaculture, electroplating, and commercial and residential sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company focuses on advanced technologies such as permanent magnet variable frequency screw compressors, magnetic levitation bearings, high-speed permanent magnet synchronous motors, and three-dimensional flow impeller designs. It employs CNC machining, rotor line development, and oil-cooled permanent magnet synchronous motors, integrating IoT for remote control and smart operation. Production combines in-house manufacturing of core components with strict quality control and ERP-based procurement and production management.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Xinlei serves a diverse customer base including industrial manufacturers, petrochemical companies, mining and metallurgy firms, textile and apparel producers, medical and food industries, cement and wastewater treatment plants, power utilities, aquaculture farms, electroplating businesses, as well as commercial real estate, hotels, data centers, airports, and residential users. International customers include well-known foreign brand companies and large retail chains.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters and manufacturing facilities in Zhejiang Province. It exports products to over 100 countries and regions worldwide, with a focus on European markets and emerging markets in Southeast Asia. Domestic sales account for approximately 74% of revenue, while exports represent about 26%.
categories.supply_chain_position: Xinlei operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on the design, manufacturing, assembly, and sales of air compressors, blowers, and HVAC equipment. It produces most core components in-house, including main machines and motors, and procures raw materials and parts from multiple suppliers to ensure quality and cost control.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation and R&D investment, focusing on energy-saving technologies, smart manufacturing, and product efficiency improvements. Key R&D projects include low-resistance separators for screw compressors, magnetic levitation centrifugal chillers, multi-stage compression technologies, and low-temperature heat pumps. It aims to enhance product performance, expand product lines, and accelerate the industrialization of new technologies while strengthening intellectual property and standards development.
categories.revenue_model: Xinlei generates revenue primarily through product sales under both Original Brand Manufacturing (OBM) and Original Design Manufacturing (ODM) models. OBM sales include dealer sales, direct sales, and contract energy management services where the company retains ownership of equipment and shares energy savings with customers. ODM sales involve designing and manufacturing products for foreign brands. The company also earns income from after-sales services and government subsidies.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with international giants like Atlas Copco, Ingersoll Rand, and Sullair in the high-end air compressor market, which dominate due to strong R&D and brand loyalty. Domestically, Xinlei is among the leading manufacturers with growing market share, especially in energy-efficient screw compressors and centrifugal blowers. It faces intense competition in the mid-to-low-end market from numerous smaller domestic firms. Xinlei emphasizes technological innovation and scale advantages to strengthen its competitive position.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Xinlei reported consolidated revenue of approximately RMB 927 million, a 19.12% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 52.36 million, reflecting a slight decline due to increased costs and investments. The company has total assets exceeding RMB 2.4 billion and net assets over RMB 1 billion. R&D expenses increased by 36.75%, indicating a strong growth trajectory supported by continuous innovation and market expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Xinlei emphasizes high efficiency, energy savings, low noise, reliability, and ease of maintenance in its products. Its proprietary technologies such as magnetic levitation bearings and permanent magnet motors provide superior energy efficiency and longer service life compared to traditional products. The company offers customized solutions and contract energy management services, enhancing customer value by reducing operational costs and environmental impact. Its strong brand reputation and extensive product range differentiate it in both domestic and international markets.
